facts.text: A July 26, 2020 Cincinnati Parks article describes a long sloped interior walkway to the Palm House and waterfall. This is a historical description, not a current route or gradient assessment.
quote: Cincinnati’s iconic flora center features a long sloped interior walkway, which provides universal access to the Palm House and the waterfall.

facts.text: The facility list includes paved walkways and benches.
The facility list includes public restrooms; their accessibility is not stated. Only service dogs are allowed inside the building.
quote: Only Service Dogs Allowed Inside Building

facts.text: Cincinnati Parks accepts reasonable-accommodation requests through its linked request form. Questions about accommodations go to 513-357-2604.
quote: Cincinnati Parks is committed to providing a quality experience at all our parks and facilities by providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request. To request an accommodation fill out a Reasonable Accommodation Request Form linked here.

facts.text: If the events calendar shows two entries with different times for your day, the accurate hours are under the 'Krohn Closes Early' or 'Krohn Closed' entry.
facts.quote: If your planned visiting day has two event entries with different times the accurate open hours will be under the entry which says "Krohn Closes Early," or "Krohn Closed."

facts.text: Tickets are sold at the door for cash, Visa or Mastercard.
facts.quote: You can purchase tickets at the door with cash, Visa, or Mastercard.

facts.text: Cincinnati Parks Foundation describes a 2019 Betty Gale Garden project that added a level concrete walk and adjusted inlets. The retrospective does not establish the garden’s current surface condition or an uninterrupted route from parking.
facts.quote: CPF stewarded a gift that reopened a long-closed section of Krohn Conservatory, the Betty Gale Garden. The garden was made fully accessible with a new, level concrete walk and adjusted inlets. (2019)

facts.text: Krohn lists general hours of 10 a.m.–8 p.m. daily, with occasional closures for private events. Check the date-specific calendar and call Krohn at 513-421-4086 with visit questions.
quote: Open Monday - Sunday 10 AM to 8 PM These are our general hours. For individual days, please check the below events calendar because Krohn is occasionally closed for private events.
